# Skills for GitHub Copilot

**Generated folder. Do not edit.**

GitHub Copilot reads skills from this folder; Claude Code reads them from `.claude/skills/`. The source is `.claude/skills/`. After changing a skill there, run this from the repository root and commit both folders together:

```
python scripts/sync_skills.py
```

The `check-skills` workflow fails a pull request if this folder is out of date.
